highlights.headline: Dean Harrison replied Mon Nov 2 at 6:12 PM ET: he has a meeting Wednesday morning (Nov 4) with Val, Subway's Media lead, to discuss the gift-card trade

highlights.tag: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings / Meghan Montana
highlights.headline: Meghan Montana named NCLH EVP and Chief Financial Officer effective Jan 1, 2027, succeeding Mark A. Kempa (GlobeNewswire, Oct 29)

NCLH Q3 beat: revenue $2.9B, adjusted EPS $1.12 vs $0.90 guided, net yield down 6.5 percent (down 6.7 percent constant currency, about 220bps better than guided), occupancy 106.5 percent, full-year guidance raised
Sherwin-Williams Q3 printed Oct 27: sales $6.86B up 7.9 percent, adjusted EPS $3.63, full-year guidance narrowed to $11.85 to $12.15, $75M 2027 savings programme, no inventory write-down disclosed

Josh Smith sent the Subway regroup check to Dean Harrison on Fri Oct 30 at 2:45 PM ET (cc Mike Allen and Alex Antonello); TheStreet reported Oct 25 (updated Oct 27) another franchisee exit, five Illinois stores surrendered, chain down 729 net US units in 2025 to 18,773
Godrej Consumer Products Q2 FY27 printed Oct 29: consolidated sales up 19 percent, net profit up 14 percent, Africa business including Strength of Nature up 40 percent

Church & Dwight Q3 printed Oct 30: sales $1,602M up 1.0 percent, organic up 5.1 percent, adjusted EPS $0.92, full-year organic guide raised to about 5 percent, and NO new stranded-cost charge or exited-line inventory write-down disclosed

WSJ Oct 30/31 confirms Campbell's simplification: $500M cost programme by 2030, 550-plus salaried jobs cut (about 13 percent), Hyannis plant closed, Jeffersonville snacks plant closing, Goldfish down 5 percent in the four weeks to Oct 3, reduced $0.25 dividend payable Nov 2

MGP Ingredients Q3 (reported Oct 28 to 30): brown spirits sales down 47 percent on elevated industry-wide barrel inventories, total sales down 10 percent to $117.9M, rebranding to Sempreon/CASK on Nov 2
Michael Francis starts as President and CEO of Old Navy today, Mon Nov 2, 2026, succeeding Haio Barbeito (announced Aug 27)
